help.title: Help
help.description: Articles, shortcuts and ways to reach us.

search.label: Search help
search.empty: No articles match "{query}". Try fewer words or another topic.
search.error: Help could not load. Try again.

help.offline: You are offline. Help articles are saved on this device and still work; contact options need a connection.

today.title: Your court day, in one view
today.body: Hearings are grouped by court and hall. Open the help icon any time for a short guide.

inbox.title: Anything that needs you lands here
inbox.body: Forwarded emails, voice notes and files wait here for a decision.

obligations.title: Obligations you owe
obligations.body: Directions and undertakings from orders collect here with their due dates.

briefs.title: Brief sheets
briefs.body: A one-page summary for each listing, ready before you stand up.

memory.title: Memory you can review
memory.body: What the workspace remembers is listed here. Confirm or remove anything.

gestures.title: Gestures
gestures.description: On a touch screen, use these instead of keyboard shortcuts.
gestures.tap: Tap a row to open it.
gestures.swipe: Swipe a notification sideways to dismiss it.
gestures.hold: Press and hold the plus button to capture.
gestures.pull: Pull a list down to refresh it.

contact.title: Contact support
contact.hours: Court-day hours: 9:00 am to 6:00 pm IST, Monday to Saturday.
contact.emailOnly: WhatsApp is not set up for this workspace. Email us instead.

request.title: Request a support session
request.description: Let our staff look at your workspace metadata for a limited time. They see no case content unless you grant it. You can end it any time from Settings, Support.
request.reason: What do you need help with?
request.sent: Request sent. Staff can pick it up once you grant access in Settings, Support.
request.error: The request could not be sent.
request.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can request a support session.

help.footer: This is software documentation, not legal advice.
